caption:
A schoolgirl outruns a zombie horde.
Seedance 2.5 directed this entire chase.
prompt:
VIDEO PROMPT — 27 seconds. 16:9 landscape (854x480). Ultra-realistic live-action Korean blockbuster zombie-action look: sharp skin, fabric, rust, dust and concrete detail, bright hard midday sun under a clear blue sky with light haze, slightly desaturated warm-teal grade, natural motion blur, 24-35mm lenses with shallow depth of field on close-ups. Camera feel: kinetic handheld and stunt-tracking with sweeping drone aerials. Pacing: relentless, a fast cut every 0.4-2.5 seconds, building to a leap from the bridge and a helicopter aerial.

CHARACTERS:
- THE SCHOOLGIRL: Korean girl, about 17, fair skin, large expressive hazel-brown eyes, rosy lips, long wavy chestnut-brown hair with the top half tied back and the rest loose and flying, black sunglasses pushed up on top of her head, small gold hoop earrings. Navy-blue school blazer with a gold-and-red crest badge on the left chest, crisp white collared shirt, red plaid bow tie, short navy-and-red plaid pleated skirt above the knee, white socks, black loafers, small black backpack. Same face, hair, sunglasses and uniform in every shot.
- THE ZOMBIES: hundreds of infected men and women in dusty, torn beige, brown and grey everyday clothes, grey-pale skin, wild eyes, blood around their mouths, sprinting and lunging with arms outstretched.

LOCATION: a long modern river bridge in Seoul across a very wide blue-green river: a straight multi-lane road with double yellow centre lines and concrete-and-steel railings, broken off mid-river so the deck ends in a jagged edge of cracked concrete with bent rusty rebar sticking out, a horizontal broken steel lamp pole (with a small CCTV camera on its tip) jutting out over the drop, rusty steel girders below. On the far bank: rows of white high-rise apartment towers and a green mountain with a tall TV tower on its summit; several grey smoke columns rise from the city. A green city bus and a white sedan sit on the bridge.

SHOT 1 (00:00.0-00:00.8) — The leap. Wide side view: THE SCHOOLGIRL sprints off the broken edge of the bridge and dives forward through the air, arms stretched ahead like a swimmer, hair streaming; zombies lunge after her from the left edge of frame, river and railing behind.
SHOT 2 (00:00.8-00:01.7) — The pole. Wide from beside the broken deck: she flies toward the broken steel lamp pole sticking out over the water as a wave of zombies spills over the jagged edge behind her. MUST SHOW: the horizontal pole over the drop.
SHOT 3 (00:01.7-00:03.3) — Hanging. Low angle from below the broken edge: she hangs by both hands from the pole, legs dangling against the cracked concrete wall; zombies leap off the edge and tumble past her, falling toward the river, dust raining down.
SHOT 4 (00:03.3-00:04.3) — The grab. Close-up of her dangling legs: a zombie man in a grey jacket with a bloody mouth clings to her calf, snarling; she kicks with her black loafer.
SHOT 5 (00:04.3-00:05.8) — Kick-off. Medium from above and in front: she hangs from the pole, arms straight up, sunglasses on her head, looking down with gritted teeth as she kicks the zombie off her leg; a rusty steel girder and dark green water far below.
SHOT 6 (00:05.8-00:08.3) — The drop. A glimpse of the river and a distant bridge, then a fast tilt down to a top-down view: she drops from the pole and grabs the jagged concrete edge of a broken pier with rusty rebar; the steel pole falls past her and smashes into the river with a white splash far below. MUST SHOW: top-down angle, the splash in the water.
SHOT 7 (00:08.3-00:10.9) — The climb. Close top-down: she hauls herself up the rough broken concrete, one hand gripping a curled rusty rebar bar, hair whipping, determined face turning up to the lens.
SHOT 8 (00:10.9-00:12.1) — The horde. She rises into frame on the bridge road, hair flying past the lens, and turns her shocked face toward the camera; behind her a horde of zombies sprints straight at her down the road, a green bus on the left, smoke in the sky.
SHOT 9 (00:12.1-00:13.9) — The car. Tracking from behind: she sprints down the sunlit road toward a white sedan driving at her, the TV-tower mountain and white apartment towers ahead; she leaps onto its bonnet.
SHOT 10 (00:13.9-00:15.4) — Onto the bus. Low side angle: she runs across the white car's roof and leaps up onto the roof of a green city bus, zombies reaching from the road.
SHOT 11 (00:15.4-00:16.8) — Bus roof. High angle on the green bus roof: her black loafers and shadow race across it past two roof hatches and a wooden baseball bat lying there; below, dozens of zombie hands reach up through the bus's smashed windows. MUST SHOW: the hands reaching from the windows.
SHOT 12 (00:16.8-00:17.9) — Inside the bus. Close inside the packed bus: a bloody-faced zombie in a suit lunges and slams against the window toward the lens, mouth open, as her hair whips past in the foreground.
SHOT 13 (00:17.9-00:18.9) — Her face. Front close-up: wide eyes, mouth open in shock, hair blowing, the river and far bank blurred behind.
SHOT 14 (00:18.9-00:20.0) — The scale. Over-the-shoulder high wide from behind her hair: the whole bridge is packed with thousands of zombies flowing toward camera around the green bus, a big smoke column rising from the city. MUST SHOW: the sea of zombies filling the bridge.
SHOT 15 (00:20.0-00:21.9) — The crash. Wide side: the green bus tips and crashes over onto the white sedan in a burst of dust while she stands on its roof; she jumps down, lands in front of the car and sprints toward camera.
SHOT 16 (00:21.9-00:22.7) — Run. Medium front, camera tracking backward fast: she sprints at the lens, blazer flapping, the zombie horde right behind her.
SHOT 17 (00:22.7-00:23.6) — The edge. Wide locked-off from beyond the broken end of the road: the jagged rebar edge in the foreground, the horde charging down the road toward it, the bus and smoke behind.
SHOT 18 (00:23.6-00:24.0) — Nowhere to go. From behind: she skids to a stop at the very edge, the wide river and apartment towers ahead.
SHOT 19 (00:24.0-00:24.8) — Last sprint. A zombie hand swipes into frame from the left; cut to a front view as she runs with the horde a step behind, arms pumping.
SHOT 20 (00:24.8-00:25.6) — The jump. From behind the zombies' heads: she leaps off the edge out over the river, arms spread wide, as the zombies grab at empty air.
SHOT 21 (00:25.6-00:27.0) — The helicopter. Wide aerial high above the river: a black military helicopter swoops in from the top of frame over the broken end of the bridge, the deck packed with zombies and the green bus, the broken pier dropping into the water; the camera holds as the helicopter hovers over the edge.

SOUND: no dialogue. A pounding orchestral action score with heavy drums. Snarls, screams and stampeding footsteps of the horde, wind rushing, metal creaking as she hangs, the pole splashing into the river (SHOT 6), car and bus impacts and crunching metal (SHOT 15), her sharp breaths, and a loud helicopter rotor thump rising in SHOT 21.
prompt_short: Realistic Korean zombie-action, 16:9, midday sun: a schoolgirl in a navy blazer and plaid skirt leaps from a broken Seoul bridge, hangs from a pole, climbs back, runs over a car and a bus roof past a zombie horde and jumps as a helicopter arrives.
